from pathlib import Path
import os,time
from ovl_pipeline.supervision import Journal
from ovl_pipeline.canonical import write_json
root=Path(__file__).parent
with Journal(root/'journal').lease() as j:
    if not j.events:
        j.append('creation-intent',{'synthetic':True,'resources_created':False})
        write_json(root/'ready.json',{'pid':os.getpid(),'synthetic':True})
        while True:time.sleep(1)
    assert len(j.events)==1 and j.events[0]['kind']=='creation-intent'
    j.append('creation-observed',{'adopted_prior_intent':True,'synthetic':True,'resources_created':False})
    write_json(root/'complete.json',{'result':'PASS','scope':'systemd restart and durable intent adoption only; no provider credit','pid':os.getpid(),'original_intent_count':1})
